Brunswick County, Virginia Tax Sales: Simple Guide to Buying Property at Auction

Brunswick County, Virginia holds public tax sales to recover unpaid property taxes. These auctions give buyers the chance to purchase real estate while helping the county collect overdue revenue. If you’re planning to bid, this guide explains the process in a straightforward way.

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

When Brunswick County Holds Tax Sales

The county doesn’t schedule tax sales on a fixed annual date. Auctions only happen when there are enough qualifying properties.

  • Auction Timing: Based on property availability
  • How to Check Dates: Visit the Auction Calendar or the county’s tax sale page

Time and Location of Auctions

All auction details are shared in the public notice before each sale.

  • Start Time: Most auctions begin at 10:00 A.M. Eastern Time (ET)
  • Where It’s Held:
    • Location: Brunswick County Courthouse Steps
    • Address: 202 North Main Street, Lawrenceville, VA

Registration and Eligibility to Bid

You must register in advance to participate in a tax sale.

  • Registration Required: Yes
  • How to Register: Instructions come with the auction notice
  • When to Register:
    • Registration opens when the auction is announced
    • It closes shortly before the auction begins

Property Redemption Period

The property owner still has a chance to stop the sale—but only up to auction day.

  • Before the Auction: They can pay the taxes and fees in full
  • After the Auction: Redemption is no longer allowed

How the Bidding and Payment Process Works

Make sure you’re ready to follow the payment rules.

  • Bidding: Highest bid wins
  • Deposit Requirements:
    • Pay $500 or 25% of the winning bid—whichever is greater
  • Final Payment:
    • Due shortly after the auction
    • Use certified checks or money orders
    • Personal checks and cash are not accepted

Where to Find Auction Updates

Check these sources for upcoming auctions and property lists:

  • Brunswick County Treasurer’s Website
  • Tax Sale Parcel List PDF – For details on available properties

Who to Contact for Help or Questions

Reach out to the Treasurer’s Office if you have questions:

  • Email: jmangrum@brunswickco.com
  • Phone: (434) 848-2512

Smart Tips for Brunswick County Tax Sales

Follow these simple tips to prepare and avoid last-minute issues:

  • Do Your Research: Know the property’s condition, access, and legal status
  • Bring Approved Payment: Only use certified funds or money orders
  • Register Early: Don’t wait until the last minute
  • Read All Terms: Understand the auction rules before you bid
  • Stay Updated: Check the Treasurer’s site regularly for any new listings
